title: How do you handle slow cash-flow months as a small business?
preview: Looking for practical ways to stay steady when sales dip temporarily.
content: We are a retail business and our sales drop for two months every year. I want to keep stock moving without over-spending. What approaches have worked for you?
author: Aisha

replies.author: Farid
replies.content: I usually build a leaner monthly forecast and freeze non-essential purchases until the sales rebound.

title: Best way to track recurring expenses in a growing business?
preview: I want a cleaner system for subscriptions, utilities, and software costs.
content: My monthly spending is becoming harder to track because the subscriptions and recurring bills are spread across different tools. I need a way to review them every month.
author: Nadia

replies.author: Hafiz
replies.content: Create a recurring-expenses category in your tracker and review it every Friday with your cash-flow summary.
